phrasings.text: Actually we use logInfo from src/lib/log.js for logging, not console.log.
No console.log in src please, everything goes through the logger in src/lib/log.js.
Please remember: logs go through logInfo/logWarn from the lib logger, never console output.
use our logger (lib/log.js) instead of console.log
We don't print with console here. logInfo or logWarn from src/lib/log.js.
